name: Gordon Murray T.33
description: The Gordon Murray T.33 is a lightweight supercar designed by legendary Formula 1 engineer Gordon Murray, creator of the McLaren F1. Unveiled in 2022, the T.33 embodies Murray's philosophy of lightweight engineering and driver engagement. At its core is a naturally aspirated 3.9-liter Cosworth GMA V12 engine that revs to an extraordinary 11,100 rpm, producing 607 hp and 451 Nm of torque. Weighing just 1,090 kg thanks to extensive use of carbon fiber, the T.33 achieves a remarkable power-to-weight ratio of 1.8 kg/hp. The car features Gordon Murray's signature iStream carbon fiber monocoque construction and a six-speed manual or paddle-shift transmission. With its clean aerodynamic design, central driving position option, and focus on analogue driving purity, the T.33 represents the pinnacle of naturally aspirated supercar engineering.
